headline: Head of TLS GROUP Explains How the EAEU-UAE Agreement Will Change Exports of Russian Goods
summary: From 6 October 2026, Russian companies will gain cheaper access to the UAE market under the EAEU-UAE agreement. TLS Group's head explained the expected change in exports of Russian goods.
why: The Eurasian Economic Union is a customs bloc led by Russia, and the UAE is a major trade and re-export hub. Preferential trade terms shift export flows and competitiveness.
